_batch: 03 输出页：高级参数分组 / JXL 参数项 / 输出选项与提示
启用可保留元数据（如 Exif、XMP、ICC 颜色配置等）: Keep metadata (Exif, XMP, ICC profile, etc.)
编码结果更大时丢弃输出（保留原文件）: Discard output when larger than the source (keep original)
删除原文件（成功转换后移入回收站）: Delete source files (move to Recycle Bin after success)
勾选后，当 JXL 输出文件不小于原文件时，丢弃该 JXL 并保留原文件（转换无: When checked, if the resulting JXL is not smaller than the source, the JXL is discarded and the original kept (conversion brought no benefit). JXL output only; automatically disabled for PNG/JPEG output.
勾选后，输出文件将按源文件原有的文件夹层级，镜像到自定义输出文件夹中（而非全部拍: When checked, output files mirror the source folder hierarchy inside the custom output folder (instead of being flattened into one directory). Applies to the "Folder" output mode only; automatically disabled when "Source folder" is selected.
勾选后，被添加的文件夹本身也会作为一层目录出现在输出中（例如拖入「照片」文件夹，: When checked, the added folder itself becomes one more level in the output path (e.g. dropping a "Photos" folder produces OutputDir/Photos/Image). Requires "Preserve folder structure" together with the "Folder" output mode.
勾选后，成功转换的输出文件将保留原文件的创建时间（仅 Windows 有效，需: When checked, successfully converted files keep the creation time of the source (Windows only, requires pywin32; ignored on other platforms, which have no creation-time concept).
勾选后，成功转换的输出文件将保留原文件的修改时间（文件管理器中显示的「修改日期」: When checked, successfully converted files keep the modification time of the source, so the "Modified" column matches the original.
勾选后，成功转换的原文件将在转换结束后移入系统回收站；转换失败的文件不会被删除。: When checked, successfully converted source files are moved to the system Recycle Bin afterwards; files that failed are never deleted.
转换全部完成后，自动打开输出文件夹（资源管理器窗口）。: Open the output folder in File Explorer automatically once everything is converted.
转换全部完成后，清空输入列表中的文件（不会删除磁盘上的原始文件）。: Clear the Input list once everything is converted (original files on disk are not deleted).
转换全部完成后播放一声提示音，便于离开电脑时也能知晓任务结束。: Play a notification sound when everything is converted, so you notice the finish even if you stepped away.
转换全部完成后自动退出本程序。: Quit the application automatically once everything is converted.
选择或输入自定义输出文件夹，下拉可查看历史路径: Select or type a custom output folder; the dropdown lists recent paths
